title: vault-meta — case shape (v0.2)
description: Pins one byte-level case for protocol::serialize_vault_meta_v0_2 + protocol::parse_vault_meta_v0_2 — the NTV5 vault.meta of a migrated v0.2 vault (docs/spec/protocol.md §9.3 + §10.4.1 + §10.5). The layout is the MYV1 layout byte-for-byte, 345 bytes, with exactly two substitutions: magic NTV5 at [0..4] and protocol_version 0x02 at [4]. Everything after those five bytes — account_number_hash, the canonical KDF param block, both wrap salts and nonces, both enc_root_key copies, items_key_id, its nonce and enc_items_key — sits at the offsets §9.3 already pins. Three case kinds: 'roundtrip' (serialize + parse agree on the bytes), 'parse_fail' (the v0.2 parser refuses an MYV1 blob) and 'parse_fail_v0_1' (the v0.1 parser refuses an NTV5 blob). The two reject kinds are the load-bearing ones and they are deliberately a PAIR: §10.5's anti-downgrade property is bidirectional, and a round-trip case alone passes in an implementation that ignores the magic entirely. Reference implementation: protocol/src/vault_meta_v0_2.rs (main myne repository).

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'vault-meta/v0.2/<descriptive-slug>'. Immutable once shipped.

oneOf.title: roundtrip — pin the v0.2 encoder's byte output and its parse

m_kib.description: Argon2id memory cost in KiB. v0.2 has NOT allocated its own KDF yet, so a vector may legitimately carry either the canonical production block or a weak test block — the case pins the ENCODING of whatever params it names, at the offsets §9.3 fixes, not a v0.2 parameter choice.

argon2_version_hex.description: Argon2 version byte, 13 (0x13 = v1.3). Parsed and validated rather than merely copied.

input_enc_root_key_password_hex.description: 64-byte wrapped root_key copy (32-byte ciphertext + 32-byte CTX tag), password side.

input_enc_root_key_recovery_hex.description: 64-byte wrapped root_key copy, recovery side. Two independent copies of the SAME root_key is what makes recovery possible without the password (§3.1).

expected_blob_hex.description: The full 345-byte vault.meta (hex). Opens with 4e545635 ('NTV5') and 02. The length is fixed by the schema pattern rather than merely described: a 345-byte record with no length field means a port that miscounts one field produces a blob of the wrong size, and that is worth failing on at validation time.

oneOf.title: parse_fail — the v0.2 parser must refuse a v0.1 blob

input_blob_hex.description: A blob the v0.2 parser must reject — canonically the same 345 bytes with MYV1 + 0x01 restored at [0..5], so magic is the ONLY difference from the roundtrip case.

expected_error.description: Rust reference: ProtocolError::InvalidVaultMeta. vault.meta rejects are deliberately NOT differentiated by cause — the file is read before any credential exists, so a caller learns 'this is not a v0.2 vault.meta' and nothing finer.

oneOf.title: parse_fail_v0_1 — the v0.1 parser must refuse a v0.2 blob

input_blob_hex.description: An NTV5 blob fed to parse_vault_meta (the v0.1 entry point). This is the direction that matters for a MIXED FLEET: an old client meeting a migrated vault must refuse it cleanly rather than half-parse a structure whose meaning it does not know.

expected_error.description: Rust reference: ProtocolError::InvalidVaultMeta, raised by the v0.1 parser.

oneOf.title: membership_absent — an NTV5 meta with no membership field

input_blob_hex.description: A 345-byte NTV5 blob with reserved byte 0x00. parse_vault_meta_v0_2 must accept it and report membership: None (unmigrated).

oneOf.title: membership_present — an NTV5 meta with the membership field

input_blob_hex.description: A 417-byte NTV5 blob with reserved byte 0x01 and the 72-byte membership field appended. parse_vault_meta_v0_2 must accept it and unseal_membership must recover the account id.

oneOf.title: membership_tampered — a flipped membership ciphertext byte must fail closed

input_blob_hex.description: The membership-present blob with the first ciphertext byte flipped. unseal_membership must fail closed (AeadFailure), never a partial read.

oneOf.title: roster_present — an NTV5 meta with the B2B roster extension

input_blob_hex.description: An NTV5 vault.meta with the B2B roster extension (reserved byte 0x02): the 417-byte single-account field followed by the roster envelope (24-byte nonce, u32 BE ciphertext length, ciphertext).

oneOf.title: roster_tampered — a flipped roster ciphertext byte must fail closed

input_blob_hex.description: The roster-present blob with the middle roster ciphertext byte flipped. unseal_membership_roster must fail closed (AeadFailure), never a partial read.

oneOf.title: roster_over_cap — a roster length past the 64 KiB cap must reject before any ciphertext read

input_blob_hex.description: The roster-present blob with the roster u32 BE ciphertext-length field pushed past the 64 KiB cap. parse_vault_meta_v0_2 must reject the length before reading any ciphertext.

oneOf.title: roster_role: an NTV5 meta with a real two-row roster carrying vault roles

input_blob_hex.description: An NTV5 vault.meta with a real two-row canonical roster (owner + member) carrying the vault role field, after the 72 single-account bytes.
